commands: for url in 'http://www2.datasus.gov.br/cid10/V2008/downloads/CID10CSV.zip' 'http://www.datasus.gov.br/cid10/V2008/downloads/CID10CSV.zip' 'https://www.datasus.gov.br/cid10/V2008/downloads/CID10CSV.zip' 'ftp://ftp.datasus.gov.br/dissemin/publicos/CID10/CID10CSV.zip' ; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} size=%{size_download}' --max-time 10 "$url" 2>/dev/null); echo "$code | $url"; done
